answer: Start by making each identity cost something real to hold. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the reef of free entry disappears, the pulse of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the dawn case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
